newsitem.title: UK: Amstrad gains after NatWest comment.
newsitem.headline: Amstrad gains after NatWest comment.

text.p: Shares in Amstrad Plc rose on Thursday as a report in the Daily Mail focused attention on yesterday's recommendation on the consumer electronics stock from NatWest Securities, market-makers said.
Amstrad shares were up 12-1/2p at 152-1/2 by 1230 GMT, after yesterday closing at their lowest level since September.
The Mail said NatWest put a value of 190p on Amstrad shares and said it believed founder Alan Sugar -- also chairman of quoted soccer club Tottenham Hotspur Plc -- "wants out" of Amstrad.
It also said NatWest had highlighted Amstrad's cash pile, expected to be 120 million stg at the end of 1996. Analysts at NatWest were not immediately available for comment.
Amstrad shares have been under a cloud since last July when they dropped sharply following the failure of takeover talks with Psion Plc.
